blocks.text: Unit Testing is the first level of testing, where individual components or modules of the software are tested in isolation. Each "unit" is a small, testable part of the software, such as a function or method. The primary goal of unit testing is to verify that each component works correctly according to its design and performs as expected.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Try writing a unit test for a simple function in your favorite programming language.
